datasets.name: Mainscrpt
datasets.sql:
select id,num,musteriid,pinkod,names,fil,status,branch,source,
(select VAL_NAME from avalute where valute=ACCEPTED_VALUTE) valute,lstrest,frest,court_status,COURT_LASTSTAT,court_OPERS,lstd,lstp,DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT,closedate
 from (
select prtid id,'' num,CUST_ID musteriid,INNORPIN pinkod,BORROWER_NAME names,(select name from filial where id=BRANCH) fil,
accepted_portfel.status(AC.PRTID) status,ac.branch branch,'ABB' source,ac.ACCEPTED_VALUTE ACCEPTED_VALUTE,accepted_portfel.lstrest(ac.prtid) lstrest, accepted_portfel.frstrest(ac.prtid,ac.ACCEPTED_VALUTE) frest
,  court_status,cour.COURT_LASTSTAT,cour.court_OPERS,accepted_portfel.lastpaydat(ac.prtid,0)lstd,accepted_portfel.lastpayamt(ac.prtid,0)lstp,
 TO_DATE('', 'dd-MM-yyyy') DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT,TO_DATE('', 'dd-MM-yyyy')  closedate  from accepted_cr_portfels ac,credit_courts cour where   ac.prtid=cour.id(+)
union all
select cr.id id,cr.numberofcredit num,cr.boorowerid musteriid,cv.passpin pinkod, s.name names ,
(select name from filial where id=cr.branchid) fil,
accepted_portfel.status(CR.ID) status,cr.branchid branch,'KRD' source,cr.currency ACCEPTED_VALUTE,accepted_portfel.cred_lst(cr.id) lstrest, accepted_portfel.cred_frs(cr.id) frest,
 cour.court_status,cour.COURT_LASTSTAT,cour.court_OPERS,accepted_portfel.lastpaydat(cr.id,1)lstd,accepted_portfel.lastpayamt(cr.id,1)lstp,
 cr.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT ,cr.closedate  from cm_portfolio cr,credit_courts cour
 ,customers s,custinfo cv where s.id=cr.boorowerid and idcust=cr.boorowerid and s.id=cv.idcust and cr.id=cour.id(+)


 ) where 1=1

datasets.name: Main_court_old
datasets.sql:
select rownum,credid,custid,pin,names,branch,id, court_ammount, court_status, court_date_num,
       court_name, court_accepted_ammount, court_desc,court_manage, court_laststat, court_measure,
       court_replace, replacement_count, investigation_org,infos, property, prop_desc, prop_address,
       porp_passport, prop_price, prop_info, closedate,DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT from(
select  rownum,ac.prtid credid,ac.cust_id custid,ac.innorpin pin ,ac.borrower_name names,ac.branch branch,cour.id, cour.court_ammount, cour.court_status, cour.court_date_num,
       cour.court_name, cour.court_accepted_ammount, cour.court_desc, cour.court_manage, cour.court_laststat, cour.court_measure,
       cour.court_replace, cour.replacement_count, cour.investigation_org,
       cour.infos, cour.property, cour.prop_desc, cour.prop_address,
       cour.porp_passport, cour.prop_price, cour.prop_info,to_date('') closedate,to_date('') DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT,cour.court_OPERS,cour.mediation_date,cour.mediation_num  from accepted_cr_portfels ac,credit_courts cour
where  ac.court_id= cour.id
union all
select  rownum,cr.id credid,cr.boorowerid custid,(select passpin from custinfo where idcust=cr.boorowerid) pin,(select name from customers where id=cr.boorowerid) names,
cr.branchid branch,
 cor.id, cor.court_ammount, cor.court_status, cor.court_date_num,
       cor.court_name, cor.court_accepted_ammount, cor.court_desc,
       cor.court_manage, cor.court_laststat, cor.court_measure,
       cor.court_replace, cor.replacement_count, cor.investigation_org,
       cor.infos, cor.property, cor.prop_desc, cor.prop_address,
       cor.porp_passport, cor.prop_price, cor.prop_info,cr.closedate closedate,cr.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT,cor.court_OPERS,cor.mediation_date,cor.mediation_num from cm_portfolio cr,credit_courts cor


 where cr.id=cor.id



  ) where 1=1
